units.source_text: “这是《扎拉图斯特拉》的作者——著名的诗人尼采。

en.t: This is Nietzsche, the famous poet and author of Thus Spoke Zarathustra.

units.source_text: 这位圣徒向他自己创造的超人寻求解脱。

en.t: This saint sought deliverance from the superman he himself had created.

units.source_text: 但他没能获得解脱，反而成了疯子。

en.t: But he could not attain deliverance; instead, he became a madman.

units.source_text: 如果不是发疯了，没准他还成不了圣徒呢……”

en.t: If he had not gone mad, perhaps he could never even have become a saint...
